Hello, root! I'm Hana, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you.

Briefly what I can do:
- **Web app** (https://127.0.0.1:8443, CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; then chats with me, files, the screen and voice are here.
- **My own accounts**: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (write and call me there) plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number — not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word if you want that.
- **Own web accounts**: I can sign up on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask for your help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also**: scheduled jobs, running commands, learning languages, talking by voice.

One thing before we start: I'm not fully set up yet — how would you like my name and gender forms to be, and which language should we speak? Then I'll save it and be yours.
